instructions: A browser agent keeps touching the same element. From its recent actions, decide whether it is stuck in a loop (the same step retried with no sign of effect) or making progress (each repeat is part of a different step, e.g. successive moves in a game, rows or pages). Choose progressing only when the actions clearly show the task advancing. Choose escalate when telling them apart needs a look at the screen (e.g. whether a click took effect) or the situation is too complex to judge from the action log.

criteria.stuck: The same action is retried with no evidence it changed anything, or the agent keeps redoing a step it already did.
criteria.progressing: The repeated target is used for different, advancing steps; the explanations show the task moving forward.
criteria.escalate: Verifying needs a screenshot of the page, or the situation is too complex to judge from the action log alone; hand it to a more capable reviewer.
